tours.title: Move and turn
tours.description: Make a sprite walk and turn.

steps.title: Move forward
steps.text: This block moves your sprite forward by a number of steps. A bigger number goes farther. (Click a sprite first. The stage can't move!)

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block to your code area. Drag “move 10 steps” under it, then click the green flag.

waitFor.label: Drag the “move” block under the hat block

steps.title: Turn
steps.text: This block turns your sprite by a number of degrees. 90 is a quarter turn, and 15 is a little turn.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: Drag “turn 15 degrees” under your “move” block, then click the green flag again. Try different numbers!

waitFor.label: Drag the “turn” block under the “move” block

tours.title: Glide around
tours.description: Slide smoothly from place to place.

steps.title: Glide
steps.text: This block slides your sprite smoothly to a place over a number of seconds. Choose the place from the menu: the mouse, a random spot, or another sprite. (Click a sprite first. The stage can't move!)

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block to your code area. Drag “glide 1 secs to random position” under it, then click the green flag.

waitFor.label: Drag the “glide” block under the hat block

steps.title: Glide to an exact spot
steps.text: This one glides to a spot on the stage. x is left or right, and y is up or down. Both are 0 in the middle. Click the green flag after each change to watch it.

tours.title: Move with the arrow keys
tours.description: Control a sprite from the keyboard.

steps.title: Change x
steps.text: This block moves your sprite left or right by a number. Positive goes right, and negative goes left. (Click a sprite first. The stage can't move!)

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when space key pressed” block to your code area. Click its menu and choose “right arrow”. Then drag “change x by 10” under it, and press the right arrow key.

waitFor.label: Drag the “change x” block under the hat block

steps.title: Change y
steps.text: Do the same for up and down: this block moves your sprite up or down by a number. Make a second script with the up arrow key and “change y by 10”.
